title: c-VEP dataset from Thielen et al. (2015)
description: A preprocessed EEG dataset from 12 healthy participants performing a brain-computer interface task based on broad-band visually evoked potentials (BBVEPs). The study implements a novel paradigm using modulated Gold codes in a 6×6 matrix speller, where participants attended target symbols during pseudo-random visual stimulation. Data were acquired at 2048 Hz from 64 electrodes and preprocessed with filtering, downsampling, and common average referencing, achieving 86% online accuracy with an information transfer rate of 48 bits per minute.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 12 healthy participants using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 64 active electrodes at 2048 Hz sampling rate. The experimental paradigm consisted of 3 runs per session with 36 trials each (4.2 seconds per trial). Visual stimulation used modulated Gold codes (126 bits, 1.05s duration) in a 6×6 matrix speller. Preprocessing included downsampling to 360 Hz, linear de-trending, common average referencing, and bandpass filtering (5-48 Hz and 52-100 Hz). Classification employed template matching with correlation and Canonical Correlation Analysis for spatial filtering.
